review: Manufacturer nominal dimensions for DIN 929, cross-checked between Boellhoff and Aspen; ISO 21670:2014 Figure 1 and Table 1 visually inspected. The DIN 2013 preview confirms coarse/fine scope but omits its dimensional pages. Fine pitches are corroborated by the manufacturer's indexed table; its direct download was unavailable. No historical CSN dimensions are reused.

cad_conventions.origin: Unwelded projection contact plane Z=0; axis through Origin; material in positive Z.
cad_conventions.din: Three native triangular corner projections and cylindrical pilot. h1 and h2 use tabulated maximum values. A 30-degree back bevel is a selected pressing detail. Thread is schematic and finite between the pilot face and back face.
cad_conventions.iso: Three rounded flange projections. m uses the maximum height measured from flange datum A; the unwelded overall axial extent is m+c. Pressing contours require a separately verified nominal CAD execution.
cad_conventions.material: Generic steel, density 7850 kg/m3. No strength class, weldability certificate or manufacturing certification is inferred from a CAD material label.
